answer: Make newcomers enter through a limited number of sponsors. A small kernel of long-standing members each gets one invitation per season, and a sponsor locks part of their own stake behind the guest. If the guest is later proven a fake, the sponsor forfeits that stake and loses the invitation. Picture a garden where every seedling needs a gardener holding a lantern for it. A farm needs a real, scarce invitation and a real bond for each fake name, so it runs out of sponsors long before it runs out of names.
